name: Rational Ray Parameterization for Octree Traversal
definition: A method to trace rays through an octree using exact rational arithmetic to avoid floating-point precision errors during cell boundary crossing and neighbor finding. It solves the problem of determining the next cell intersected by a ray when the ray parameters are not integers.
summary: Rational Ray Parameterization for Octree Traversal uses exact rational arithmetic to trace rays through octrees, ensuring robustness by avoiding floating-point precision errors during cell boundary crossing and neighbor finding.
